   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: Aug 4, 2026 - Nov 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Agnes Caruso_, Nov 9, 2026, 1/5: "Just stopped working. Suddenly MFP stopped opening, it just crashes when you try to log food. It literally worked yesterday morning and yesterday evening just crashes constantly. I used MFP for over 10 years and it was always great. I have other options but I like having data continuity."
            2. _Thorsten Mootz_, Aug 30, 2026, 1/5: "New update is really bad and user unfriendly. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
            3. _Harun_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
